Tara: remote welcome! short clips or hop on for a bit. also vote: classic cocoa, spiced chai, or peppermint? react to vote.
phil-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Cocoa & Mugs" Tue 3:00 PM PT — optional.
Eli: in-office plan: hot water + cocoa mix at cafe corner. leave a note if you bring extras. please label jars.
Nora: recipe share: 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tsp sugar, dash cinnamon, steamed milk. optional marshmallows.
Sam: i voted peppermint. will DM a 20s mug tour if i can't make live.
Tara: can we do a tiny photo collage in #random after? i'll assemble. :frame_with_picture:
Eli: cool — i'll post a quick poll result and the collage link after. see small holiday smiles!
